visual_text: Nerve block for a broken hip
Block the pain before the moves
One injection: several hours of relief
Compared with no block, pain on movement was about 2.5 points lower out of 10 within half an hour (Cochrane review).
Guay and Kopp, Cochrane 2020; Association of Anaesthetists 2020
alt_text: Flow of five steps after a broken hip: nerve block in the emergency department, X-ray, move to the ward, nursing care, surgery with another block advised. A fading bar shows one injection gives several hours of relief. Pain on movement was about 2.5 points lower out of 10 within half an hour.
